title: Close @kanbus/api-client type gaps found by Chatticus
description: Found by the Chatticus session 2026-10-20 while building against @kanbus/api-client 0.1.0. (1) KanbusIssuePatch and the create input lack dependencies (and the dependency link type), although the server accepts dependency writes since PR 510; add them, typed like the server's dependency links. (2) Document that create has no client-chosen id: the server generates <project_key>-<uuid v4>. (3) Document that list pages carry no catalog_pending (only writes do): list results come from the catalog and may briefly lag a write that reported catalog_pending true. (4) Document that idempotent replay compares method, path, body, actor and If-Match: a retry must resend the original If-Match, and a different one returns 409 operation_conflict. (5) Document that custom keys merge shallowly and null sets the key to JSON null (it does not remove it). Add type tests; release as @kanbus/api-client 0.1.1.
